g.text: Assay-aware ridge baselines under grouped chemical shift
46 rows / 43 candidates / 12 studies; same 9 study-and-constitution leave-out groups
All encoding and penalty selection use inner training groups only. Missingness is a separate control.
Points and counts have no uncertainty intervals. These results do not identify pure assay bias.
